note: Public news feeds polled by the news process N (python/balancita_engine/futures_news.py). https only (plain http is accepted for loopback test servers). The first four are the feeds of the legacy news feature (server/src/features/news: the SEC, ECB and Federal Reserve press feeds from OFFICIAL_RSS_SOURCES and The Block from NEWS_EXTRA_RSS_FEEDS); the rest are public crypto newsroom feeds added for N. Extra feeds can be appended with NEWS_EXTRA_RSS_FEEDS (sourceId|label|https url|unknown or licensed, comma separated, the legacy format). The text of an item is stored, sanitized and capped, and is only ever sent to the local model.
